pm-docker-diagnostics
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Write-Host '--- winget list ---'; winget list --id Docker.DockerDesktop; Write-Host '--- where docker ---'; where.exe docker; Write-Host '--- appx package ---'; Get-AppxPackage -Name '*DockerDesktop*' | Select-Object Name, Version, InstallLocation; Write-Host '--- uninstall keys HKLM/HKCU ---'; Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*','HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*' | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -like '*Docker*' } | Select-Object DisplayName, InstallLocation, UninstallString; Write-Host '--- common paths ---'; Write-Host ('PF desktop=' + (Test-Path 'C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe')); Write-Host ('PF cli=' + (Test-Path 'C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\resources\bin\docker.exe')); Write-Host ('LA desktop=' + (Test-Path 'C:\Users\mangl\AppData\Local\Programs\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe')); Write-Host ('LA cli=' + (Test-Path 'C:\Users\mangl\AppData\Local\Programs\Docker\Docker\resources\bin\docker.exe'));"
